同じ試合、まったく違う価格：Who sells the experience?

A company can package the same match with hotels, food and privileged access, then sell a very different product. オン・ロケーションのNFL起源、五輪での損失、2026年W杯での大型販売を比較し、独占的な権利と利益の違いを考える。The key is not luxury alone; it is risk allocation, demand forecasting and reliable delivery.
